items.source: MongoTemplate and ReactiveMongoTemplate provide methods for managing indexes and collections. These methods are collected into a helper interface called IndexOperations respectively ReactiveIndexOperations. You can access these operations by calling the indexOps method and passing in either the collection name or the java.lang.Class of your entity (the collection name is derived from the .class, either by name or from annotation metadata).
items.translation: MongoTemplate 和 ReactiveMongoTemplate 提供了用于管理索引和集合的方法。这些方法被封装到名为 IndexOperations 和 ReactiveIndexOperations 的辅助接口中。您可以通过调用 indexOps 方法来访问这些操作，并传入集合名称或实体的 java.lang.Class（集合名称可从.class 派生，通过名称或注解元数据）。

items.source: You can use the @TimeSeries#expireAfter option to have MongoDB automatically remove expired buckets. The attribute allows different timeout formats like 10s, 3h,…​ as well as expression (#{@mySpringBean.timeout}) and property placeholder (${my.property.timeout}) syntax.
items.translation: 您可以使用@TimeSeries#expireAfter选项，让 MongoDB 自动删除过期的桶。该属性支持不同的超时格式，如10s、3h等，同时也支持表达式（#{@mySpringBean.timeout}）和属性占位符（${my.property.timeout}）语法。

items.source: MongoDB 5.0 introduced Time Series collections that are optimized to efficiently store documents over time such as measurements or events. Those collections need to be created as such before inserting any data. Collections can be created by either running the createCollection command, defining time series collection options or extracting options from a @TimeSeries annotation as shown in the examples below.
items.translation: MongoDB 5.0 引入了时间序列集合，该集合经过优化，可高效存储随时间变化的文档（如测量数据或事件）。 在插入任何数据之前，必须将这些集合创建为时间序列类型。 可以通过运行 createCollection 命令、定义时间序列集合选项，或从 @TimeSeries 注解中提取选项来创建集合，如下面的示例所示。

items.source: ensureIndex makes sure that an index for the provided IndexDefinition exists for the collection.
items.translation: `ensureIndex` 确保为集合提供了指定索引定义的索引已存在。

items.source: getCollectionNames: Returns a set of collection names.
items.translation: getCollectionNames：返回一个集合名称的集合。

items.source: collectionExists: Checks to see if a collection with a given name exists.
items.translation: collectionExists：检查是否存在具有给定名称的集合。

items.source: createCollection: Creates an uncapped collection.
items.translation: createCollection：创建一个无上限集合。

items.source: dropCollection: Drops the collection.
items.translation: dropCollection：删除集合。

items.source: getCollection: Gets a collection by name, creating it if it does not exist.
items.translation: getCollection：根据名称获取集合，如果该集合不存在则创建它。
